title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy, pursuant to the Restructuring Settlement Agreement filed in Docket D.P.U./D.T.E. 96-23, and pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws, c. 164, § 76, of (a) the sale by Boston Edison Company of its fossil generating assets to Sithe Energies, Inc., (b) the adjustment of the Company's access charge after the completion of the sale to reflect the residual value credit as calculated in accordance with the Settlement Agreement and (c) Boston Edison's recovery through the access charge of sale-related costs, including without limitation, labor expenses and property tax expenses.
